stories.headline: No articles were provided for analysis
stories.whatHappened: The article list passed into this prompt appears to be empty or unpopulated — the template variable $json.articlesText did not resolve to any content.
stories.clientTalkingPoint: This briefing could not be generated due to a data pipeline issue — the articles feed needs to be checked to ensure content is being passed correctly before the next briefing cycle.

stories.headline: Template variable $json.articlesText appears unresolved
stories.whatHappened: No article data was injected into the prompt, meaning the upstream n8n node either failed to populate the variable or passed an empty string.
stories.clientTalkingPoint: Data pipeline integrity is critical — even automated briefing tools require validation steps to confirm inputs are populated before generation runs.

stories.headline: Briefing generation halted — no source material available
stories.whatHappened: Without verified articles to draw from, the analyst cannot fabricate or assume news content, so no stories can be responsibly selected.
stories.clientTalkingPoint: Responsible AI use means refusing to hallucinate content — this blank output is the correct behaviour when source data is missing.

additionalHeadlines.headline: Check n8n workflow: articlesText node output may be null or empty
additionalHeadlines.whyRelevant: The $json.articlesText variable resolved to no content — verify the upstream HTTP Request or RSS node returned data and that the field mapping is correct.

additionalHeadlines.headline: Verify sourcesList and topicsList variables also resolved correctly
additionalHeadlines.whyRelevant: Multiple template variables in this prompt may be unresolved, suggesting a broader workflow execution issue rather than a single field problem.

additionalHeadlines.headline: Consider adding an input validation node before the AI generation step
additionalHeadlines.whyRelevant: A simple IF node checking that articlesText is non-empty would prevent wasted AI API calls and surface pipeline failures earlier.
